metadata.name: Disable Laravel debug output in production diagnosis

diagnosis.condition: Disable Laravel debug output in production.
diagnosis.expected_state: For APP_ENV=production, APP_DEBUG is absent or an exact supported false value.
diagnosis.probable_cause: The observed application debug enabled condition differs from the required state.
diagnosis.automation_reason: Only an execution-owned project .env with unambiguous APP_ENV=production and one enabled APP_DEBUG assignment is changed; a secret-safe exact snapshot and post-repair hash guard support rollback.

repair_generation.name: Disable Laravel debug output in production
repair_generation.backup_strategy: secret-safe exact .env snapshot with post-repair hash guard
required_permissions: execution-account ownership and write access to the project .env

action.description: Set the one unambiguous production APP_DEBUG assignment to false without recording any other environment values.
